fr.title: Feature requests
fr.sub: Ask for something new the shop cannot do yet. The build team adds it to the PR register and builds it; nobody edits code by hand.
fr.readOnly: You can see the requests; asking for one needs permission to report on the build.

ways.title: First: can it be done already?
ways.sub: Most changes need no new feature. Check these first.

switches.title: Switches and settings
switches.text: Every optional feature has an on/off switch and its numbers in its own section. The Site manual explains each one.

rules.title: Smart Rules and automations
rules.text: Offers, prices with your OK, delivery rules, messages that go out by themselves.

keys.title: Integrations
keys.text: Couriers, payments, messages and other services: type their key in and switch them on.

words.title: Words on the shop
words.text: Every word the shop shows, in English and Bengali.

ask.heading: Ask for a new feature
ask.sub: Say what you need in your own words. You will see here when it is in the register, built, or already possible.
ask.title: A short name
ask.needHint: Who uses it, what happens step by step, and why it helps. Plain words are fine.
ask.note: A request never changes the shop by itself.
ask.sent: Sent. The build team will put it in the register.

when.SOON: Soon: it holds up daily work

st.where: Where it can be done already
st.why: Why it will not be built

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is missing. A short name (3 letters or more) and what it should do (10 letters or more).
err.NOTE_NEEDED: Say where it is possible already, or why it will not be built.
err.NOT_FOUND: This request is not here any more. Reload the page.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
